name: Atharva Dhone

projects.name: GridWise AI
projects.subtitle: Smart Electricity Demand Forecasting
highlights: Developed an LSTM-based forecasting pipeline to predict household electricity consumption for the next 24 hours using historical power usage data.
Designed an interactive dashboard featuring consumption trends, actual vs. predicted usage, peak-hour detection, and estimated electricity bills.
Integrated forecasting outputs with anomaly detection and actionable energy-saving recommendations to support smarter household electricity management.

projects.name: Zaika AI
projects.subtitle: AI-Powered Recipe Assistant
highlights: Trained a dual-encoder embedding model with in-batch InfoNCE loss to rank recipes by ingredient compatibility, evaluated via precision@k, recall@k, and MRR.
Built a retrieval-augmented chatbot grounded in a curated knowledge base to handle ingredient substitutions and dietary adaptations without hallucinated advice.
Engineered a FastAPI backend with a FAISS-indexed vector search pipeline and a React frontend, validated through 22 integration tests against the live trained model.

projects.name: WhatsApp Chat Analyzer
highlights: Built a regex-based parser to extract users, timestamps, and messages from raw WhatsApp export files into structured, analyzable data.
Generated message/word/media statistics, word clouds, and emoji usage breakdowns for both individual users and overall group activity.
Designed monthly, daily, and weekly activity timelines to surface usage trends and identify the most active users and periods.
